title: Confirm dialog
description: confirmDialog() asks one yes / no question and resolves to true or false. Mount ConfirmHost once in the root layout. Never window.confirm.
when: Before deleting, stopping a print or discarding changes.
a11y: An alertdialog: focus starts on the safe button (Huỷ), Escape cancels.
notes: <ConfirmHost /> goes once in the root layout (see Theme › Root layout); confirmDialog() works from any event handler.
